purpose: Fresh Stripe repositories: none was in the original 100 or the held-out 50, and none was inspected, scanned or used to tune Refit before this list was frozen.
criteria: GitHub code search, 13 queries for stripe-node usage in TypeScript and JavaScript (constructors, imports, checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, invoices), returned 6,363 repositories. After excluding the 150 used before, 3,034 were not archived, under 50 MB, pushed since 2024-01-01 and declared stripe in the root package.json. The 400 most starred were cloned at their default-branch HEAD; 17 run an API version without a published spec (stripe-node below 10, or a 2020 pin) and 2 are already on the target. The remaining 381 are all kept, in star order.
